name: Blue-Hour Resolve
description: Minimal, urban, slightly tailored — clothes read as practical and private. Keep silhouettes clean to emphasize restrained performance and pocket/action. Fabrics matte to avoid distracting reflections under station lighting.

suggestionSnapshot.wardrobeDirection: Minimal, urban, slightly tailored — clothes read as practical and private. Keep silhouettes clean to emphasize restrained performance and pocket/action. Fabrics matte to avoid distracting reflections under station lighting.

garments.upper: Fitted black lightweight merino turtleneck (long sleeve, no logos)
garments.lower: Charcoal mid-rise tapered trousers in cotton-twill (ankle length)
garments.outerwear: Charcoal mid-thigh single-breasted wool-blend coat with concealed buttons and straight hem (pocket on right hip)
garments.footwear: Black leather ankle boots, low stable heel (1–2 inches), minimal detailing
accessories: Plain slim black case phone (prop already specified)
Small unadorned silver stud earrings (one pair)
Thin matte-black leather wrist strap watch or band (optional; keep face off-camera)

suggestionSnapshot.rationale: A compact, neutral outfit preserves the character's private, resilient presence and reads clearly in cool blue-hour lighting. The mid-thigh coat gives a decisive motion anchor for the pocketing action and exit walk; tapered trousers and low-heel boots support natural, quiet movement without calling attention. Matte fabrics prevent hot highlights on close-ups of face, clock and phone.
movementConstraints: Coat pockets must be reachable for a single, clean phone-pocketing action (test right-hip pocket depth).
Tapered ankle trousers should allow a full stride; avoid overly constrictive waistbands.
Boot heel must be low and stable to enable controlled, quiet walking toward exit.
continuityNotes: Always pocket phone into the same coat pocket (right hip) and maintain the same phone orientation in hand for every take.
Keep earrings and watch presence consistent across shots; if the watch face is visible, lock it at the same time for clock continuity or keep face off-camera.
Coat buttoning: leave coat open for all shots to preserve consistent silhouette and visibility of turtleneck.
Maintain same trouser hem length and boot scuff level for intercut close-ups and long shots.
warnings: Avoid shiny or satin fabrics — they produce specular highlights under station lights and reflections that conflict with the photorealistic brief.
Long coats with trailing hems can catch wind or create continuity drift between takes; keep hem straight and minimal.
Dark matte garments can lose detail in shadow; ensure lighting separates coat from background to prevent silhouette merge.

name: Blue-Hour Platform: Quiet Resolve
description: Understated, modern urban: garments read neutral and practical at 9:16 close scale, with cool midtones on camera-left and a single warm accent toward the exit on camera-right. Keep silhouette slim and unadorned so facial micro-expressions remain focal. All pieces must be plain, matte, and consistent across cuts for continuity.

suggestionSnapshot.wardrobeDirection: Understated, modern urban: garments read neutral and practical at 9:16 close scale, with cool midtones on camera-left and a single warm accent toward the exit on camera-right. Keep silhouette slim and unadorned so facial micro-expressions remain focal. All pieces must be plain, matte, and consistent across cuts for continuity.

garments.upper: Charcoal lightweight knit crewneck (close-fitting, long sleeves, no logos, matte finish).
garments.lower: High-rise straight-leg black denim trousers (clean hem, minimal texture).
garments.outerwear: Mid-thigh charcoal single-breasted wool-blend coat with simple concealed buttons (unstructured shoulders, easy to remove/replace between takes).
garments.footwear: Matte black low-heel leather ankle boots (slip-resistant soles for safety on damp concrete).
accessories: Slim black compact shoulder bag (worn crossbody or on shoulder; small enough to tuck phone into quickly)
Plain black hair tie (if needed to secure existing hairstyle between takes)

palette: deep slate blue (subtle in knit texture)
warm amber (for small reflected rim from exit light)
suggestionSnapshot.rationale: Neutral dark layers hold detail in close-ups without distracting from facial acting. The mid-thigh coat gives a clean vertical line for full-body walk shots and can be removed or draped for subtle continuity changes (pocketing the phone). A small warm reflection from the coat/bag edges reads the shift toward the exit light without altering her baseline cool palette.
movementConstraints: Coat should be unstructured to allow easy arm movement for bringing phone to ear/pocket and for the final walk without flapping.
Boots must have good grip—platform is damp; ensure soles are tested for slip resistance.
Bag strap length fixed between takes to keep pocketing motion consistent.
continuityNotes: Maintain exact placement of hair tie and bag strap each shot; mark positions on costume to preserve pocketing action and silhouette.
Keep coat buttoning state consistent: decide 'open' or 'closed' for all takes and stick to it.
Phone always black and matte; when pocketed, same pocket used across shots.
warnings: Glossy or reflective trims will create stray highlights under station lighting—avoid.
Bulky layers can obscure subtle breathing/jaw movement in close-ups—do not add scarves or collars.
Any visible branding or patterned lining will break the understated mood and continuity—remove labels.
